region.note: predict a probability map over exactly this 4096x4096 level-2 region

ground_truth.origin: 2023 Grand-Prize-era human ink annotation (villa ink-detection train_scrolls inklabels) registered onto the re-flattened SOTA geometry

registration.method: obj-exact: original.obj vt NN bridge via on-7.91um tifxyz (same pipeline as the segment's y4000_x2500 target), vt convention rowHv_colu
registration.validation_basis: DOUBLE-validated: (1) 4-candidate teacher-enrichment probe (rowHv_colu 3.13 vs 0.81/1.50/1.10) AND (2) independent teacher-free surface-texture NCC (rowHv_colu 0.280 raw / 0.231 tile-median vs <=0.016 for alternatives, ~15x runner-up) — two orthogonal checks agree; plus residual + periodicity gates
registration.caveat: PLACEMENT FAILED (53.3px > 48px gate). scrollgt score refuses this target unless --allow-failing-placement is passed. The ~8-voxel median residual measures correspondence SCATTER, not placement; do not read it as a placement guarantee.

placement.note: FAILS the placement gate. Agreement with the canon prediction peaks 53.3 level-2 px (0.51mm) from zero shift, over the 48px limit, with per-768px-tile scatter sd 21.9/13.2 and the worst tile ~102px (~0.98mm). Both regions of segment 20230702185753 are affected (the y4000_x2500 region measures 46.6px); segment 20231210121321 is 3-4x tighter at 32.0px. This is cross-scan surface disagreement between the 2023 and 2026 segmentations, not a correctable offset. Scoring against this target measures misalignment as much as reading.

role: second region of the train-exposed segment; TRAIN-EXPOSED for the distilled and GT-fine-tuned baseline models (disclosed); clean for any model not trained on this segment

scoring.reason: Marked non-scoring 2026-08-14. Local placement error on this segment reaches ~102 level-2 px (~0.98 mm), which is ~1.9x the 512 um prize analysis window (64 px at 8 um) -- so within a single window a model can be scored against ground truth from a different part of the sheet. Both regions of 20230702185753 are affected; 20231210121321 stays scoreable at 0.94 windows worst-case. Published rows for this target remain in baselines/BASELINES.md as the train-region contrast that shows why held-out evaluation matters; they are a record, not a bar to beat. This region also FAILS the placement gate outright (53.3 px), indistinguishable from the 55.1 px 20231005123336 region that was withheld.
